About us

"Nature offers the purest form of nourishment — we just bring it to your door."

At Frunch Forest, our mission is simple: to bring you best-quality dry fruits, nuts and seeds that deliver freshness, purity, and an unforgettable crunch in every bite.

Every batch is handpicked, hygienically processed, and packed to travel — so a family in any corner of India can open a pack and taste exactly what came off the farm. With Frunch Forest, every bite is a step toward a healthier lifestyle.

Our Journey

From the source to your doorstep

Every pouch carries a story of care — from sourcing to quality checks, processing, packing, and final delivery.

01 — Sourced

Carefully selected suppliers

We begin with trusted sources so the journey starts with quality, consistency, and respect for the produce.

02 — Quality Checked

Every batch inspected

Each lot is reviewed for freshness, cleanliness, and standards before it moves forward.

03 — Hygienically Processed

Cleaned & sorted

The product is carefully prepared and sorted to preserve its natural goodness and texture.

04 — Packed

Sealed for freshness

We seal every pack to protect quality and keep the experience as fresh as possible.

05 — Delivered

From Frunch Forest to your doorstep

The final step is simple: bringing premium dry fruits to homes across India with care and consistency.

One continuous journey — from forest to your family's table.

Yes. Our dry fruits are carefully sourced and packed without added preservatives or artificial colours. We focus on fresh, natural quality instead of chemical shortcuts.

We work with trusted sourcing partners and bring in quality nuts and dry fruits from reliable origins, with a strong focus on freshness, grade and consistency.

Most products have a shelf life of around 6 to 12 months depending on the item and storage conditions. We recommend keeping them sealed and stored in a cool, dry place.

Store the packs in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, transfer the contents to an airtight container to preserve their crunch and freshness.

Cash on Delivery availability may vary by location and order value. Please reach out to us directly for the latest options on your delivery area.

Yes, we ship across India. Delivery timelines vary by city and pin code, but we aim to make the process smooth and reliable for every order.

We accept common online payment methods for customer convenience. For specific payment options on a particular order, feel free to contact us before checkout.
